title: ITP-STDP: A Hardware-Efficient Intrinsic-Timing Power-of-Two Synaptic Learning Engine for On-Chip SNNs
abstract: arXiv:2606.06159v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) have the potential to emerge as the third generation of neural networks and have attracted increasing attention across a wide range of applications. However, the large number of synaptic connections in SNNs leads to intensive weight-update computation by on-chip learning algorithms during training, resulting in substantial hardware resource utilization and energy consumption. translated_title: ITP-STDP：一种面向片上脉冲神经网络的高效硬件内在时序二次幂突触学习引擎
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）有望成为第三代神经网络，并在广泛的应用领域中受到越来越多的关注。然而，SNN中大量的突触连接导致训练期间片上学习算法需要进行密集的权重更新计算，从而造成大量的硬件资源占用和能耗。在现有的SNN学习算法中，脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）是研究最广泛、应用最普遍的算法之一，是SNN中基础性的学习组件。为解决SNN训练相关的硬件和能耗开销，本文提出了内在时序二次幂STDP（ITP-STDP）及其对应的原型学习引擎硬件架构。该设计通过专用的平均场突触漂移模型进行动力学分析评估，并进一步验证……
tldr: 本文提出了ITP-STDP，一种采用二次幂权重与内在时序机制的硬件高效STDP学习引擎及其原型硬件架构，显著降低了片上SNN训练的硬件资源消耗与能耗。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ITP-STDP, a hardware-efficient STDP learning engine with power-of-two weights and intrinsic-timing mechanisms along with its prototype hardware architecture, which substantially reduces hardware resource utilization and energy consumption for on-chip SNN training.
